text.title: FreshDrop, customer ecosystem, Moscow, September 2026
text.touch: app, website, bank card app, messenger bot; reach: 60% of orders
text.lead: Slot reminder and weekly list: bring in and activate new buyers
text.value: FreshDrop app: the core product, orders in 30 minutes
text.value_m: 1.8 orders per buyer a week (app analytics)
text.profit: Delivery fee and subscription: earns on each order
text.engage: Recipes and gift cards: other needs, more visits
text.engage_m: 2.4 visits a week per user (app analytics)
text.upsale: Fresh flowers and pet food: extra-profit add-ons
text.retain: Loyalty points and saved baskets bring the next order
text.transfer: from the bank app to FreshDrop: card payment and loyalty points; level: transactions
text.platform: One profile across app, bank app and messenger; one login
text.ops: Auto-routing and stock sync; courier cost per order 149 RUB
text.decision: Keep loyalty points in the bank app, close the gift card pilot; check courier cost per order monthly
